parts.title: Memory management and virtual machines (a)
parts.text: Explain how paging is used in memory management.

scheme.mark_scheme:
enables processes to share physical memory (1)
supports features like virtual memory (1)
breaks address space into blocks of the same size called “pages” (1)
divides physical memory into blocks (of the same size) called "frames" (1)
page table maps virtual pages to physical frames (1)
[Max 3]
Do not accept “divides data”

points.criterion: Enables processes to share physical memory
Supports features like virtual memory
Breaks address space into blocks of the same size called pages
Divides physical memory into blocks of the same size called frames
Page table maps virtual pages to physical frames

scheme.model_answer: Paging breaks the address space into same-sized pages and physical memory into same-sized frames. A page table maps virtual pages to physical frames, enabling processes to share physical memory and supporting virtual memory.
